summary: Yemen requires a visa obtained in advance from a Yemeni diplomatic mission: Canada's travel advice says Yemeni authorities do not issue visas at ports of entry, and the Embassy of Yemen in Washington, which requires an invitation letter from Yemen's Department of Immigration for every application, says it is not issuing tourist visas at this time.

payments.text: Canada's travel advice says Yemen's economy is primarily cash-based, credit cards are accepted only in some major hotels, and ATMs may only be available in major cities.

safety.text: The FCDO advises against all travel to the whole of Yemen because of unpredictable security conditions, and says anyone there should leave. Since July 2026 the Houthis have launched strikes on Saudi territory and shipping, with a risk of further escalation; there is a high threat of terrorism and kidnapping, and landmines are a risk on the roads. British Embassy services in Sana'a are suspended, so consular help is severely limited.

tips.text: The UK and Canadian governments both advise against all travel to Yemen, including Socotra; Canada cites armed conflict, terrorist attacks and kidnapping.
The UK Foreign Office says there are not many ATMs outside Sana'a and US dollars in cash are the most easily convertible currency; Canada says credit cards are accepted only in some major hotels.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Yemen?
faq.answer: Yes. The Embassy of Yemen in Washington requires an invitation letter from Yemen's Department of Immigration for every visa, lists Gulf states including Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait and Bahrain among the nationalities that need one, and says it is not issuing tourist visas at this time. Canada's travel advice says Yemeni authorities do not issue visas at ports of entry.

faq.question: Is it safe to visit Yemen?
faq.answer: No. The UK and Canadian governments both advise against all travel to Yemen, and the UK Foreign Office says emergency services have severely limited capacity because of the conflict.

faq.question: Can tourists still visit Socotra?
faq.answer: Canada's travel advice says to avoid all travel to Yemen, including the island of Socotra, which it says has been under the de facto control of a separatist group since 2020. The UK advises against all travel to the whole of Yemen.

faq.question: Does Yemen have an eVisa or visa on arrival?
faq.answer: No official source we could read describes a Yemeni eVisa. Canada's travel advice says Yemeni authorities do not issue visas at ports of entry and that you must obtain your visa well in advance at the closest Yemeni diplomatic mission.

faq.question: Can I enter Yemen with an Israeli passport or Israeli stamps?
faq.answer: No official source we could read states Yemen's rule for Israeli passport holders. Canada's travel advice says you could be denied entry if your passport bears an Israeli visa or border stamp, or an Egyptian or Jordanian border stamp issued at a crossing with Israel.
